title: Boondi Raita
description: Whisked yogurt studded with crisp gram-flour boondi and a light tempering of roasted cumin — a cooling side for a spicy meal.
steps: Soak the boondi in warm water for 5 minutes to soften slightly, then drain and gently squeeze out the excess water.
Whisk the curd in a bowl until smooth, adding a splash of water if it's very thick.
Add the roasted cumin powder, red chilli powder and salt to the curd, and mix well.
Stir in the softened boondi just before serving so it stays slightly crisp.
Garnish with a light dusting of red chilli powder and coriander leaves. Chill for 15 minutes before serving if time allows.
